headline: Strong EEI Growth; Alucast Decline Limits Overall Growth

highlights: The management continues to target segment-level breakeven in FY27 Capacity Expansion to Support Next Leg of Margin Improvement ▪ The management is targeting 20–25% FY27 growth in EEI segment, supported by demand from data centres, electrification and grid modernisation.

The company is developing integrated solution across measurement, power quality, energy monitoring and automation Strong EEI Growth; Alucast Decline Limits Overall Growth RISHABH reported 8.4% YoY and 7.3% QoQ increase in consolidated revenue to INR 2,128 Mn in Q2FY27.
Growth was primarily driven by the Electrical & Electronic Instruments (EEI) segment, which grew 24.9% YoY, supported by new customer wins in Poland and strong sales in the US.
However, overall growth was partly offset by lower revenue from Lumel Alucast, as the company prioritised profitability over volume growth.
valuation: The management continues to target segment-level breakeven in FY27 Capacity Expansion to Support Next Leg of Margin Improvement ▪ The management is targeting 20–25% FY27 growth in EEI segment, supported by demand from data centres, electrification and grid modernisation.
Valuation & View We expect RISHABH to deliver a Revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR of 16%/20%/21% over FY26–FY29E.
Our target price implies a P/E of 25x average of FY28-29E EPS.
